skillFull: Bees arrive one by one, carrying honey at certain intervals. Once all the honey has been collected from the bees, the Pet creates a Royal Honeydrop Jelly. Occasionally, a bee carrying Life Honey appears, which the Pet uses to create a Life Honeydrop Jelly instead. Level Up for more points for Royal Honeydrop Jellies, and more Energy restored by Life Honeydrop Jellies
story:
Every last one of its hundreds upon thousands of hexagonal wax chambers is packed to the brim with sweet honey and treasures for its sovereign, ready to present them to the Empress before a single command is given, Truly an efficiency that defies explanation.

And somehow, it even carries the Worker Bees who will become the wings of the empire, all on those tiny little wings of its own. How does it manage to carry so much? Honestly, you have to see it to believe it!

costumes.name: Rosey Groundskeeper
costumes.info: Despite being located in the farthest corner of the Allulose Empire, the Rose Nebula's garden blooms beautifully. It's all thanks to Grand Beehive's efforts! Its main duty: regularly making the rounds and releasing worker bees to tend to the flowers! Seeing the space roses sparkle like the stars beings the Pet just as much pride as watching the worker bees grow up. Perhaps it's that sense of pride that keeps the roses pristine and healthy,
